claim.scope_statement: Claims a largest globally axiom-compatible solution rule via compact pruning and exact elimination reformulation; continuous-section sufficient criterion, strict/fully-mixed and nongeneric zero-sum polymatrix cases, duplicate/strong-embedding transfers, two payoff-limit counterexamples, and a Hopf-map obstruction; universal S1 remains unresolved.
